test_case.test_name: AMD GFX poison one-shot CPER generation and retired VRAM bad-page persistence
test_case.purpose: Inject the approved GFX poison-consumption ODECC event into one immutable AMD GPU target, prove the newly correlated CPER matches the source field oracle, and verify the normalized retired bad-page set remains identical after the approved warm reset or reboot.
required_package: FAE-approved amdgpuras release/checksum and documented device0/block2/type8 semantics for the exact GPU/firmware/driver
GPU device-index/card/serial/UUID/BDF/OAM map and dedicated idle SUT
Authenticated HTTPS Redfish BMC endpoint/credentials, Dump LogService schema and approved CPER attachment method
Pinned cdump_analyzer/schema and approved CPER UMC/GC/location/code/type/severity matrix
Bad-page normalization rule, one-shot authorization, OOB, reset-to-OS-ready and GPU recovery plan
test_case.test_command: On the isolated SUT, preserve all existing logs, authenticated Redfish Dump entry metadata and the exact GPU's normalized `gpu_vram_bad_pages` set. Reconfirm device0/card/UUID/BDF/OAM immediately before the hold point. After explicit one-shot injection and reset authorization, execute only the approved `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 2 -t 8`. Correlate the new Redfish entry by pre/post set, Created time and event content, download through its authenticated AdditionalDataURI/OEM attachment, hash and decode it with the pinned analyzer, compare every required CPER field, record the post-injection bad-page set, then perform the approved warm reset or reboot and prove OFF/transition-to-OS-ready/GPU health plus identical normalized bad-page set. Never retry.
test_case.expected_result: The one injection returns the approved success indication, exactly one event-correlated CPER artifact is preserved and decodes to the specified OAM/location and UMC/GC code/type/severity evidence, the retired bad-page set changes only as the approved oracle expects before reset, and the same normalized set persists after the GPU and OS return healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable GPU/OAM identity, one-shot command evidence, pre/post Redfish set correlation, attachment hash, complete decoded field match, normalized bad-page sets before and after reset, and healthy reset recovery. A dmesg line, maximum-ID increment alone, missing CPER sections, reordered text or an automatic retry cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT with OOB and explicit FAE one-shot injection plus reset authorization
Revalidate device0/card/UUID/BDF/OAM immediately before injection and preserve all pre-existing logs/CPER
Use authenticated encrypted Redfish/file transfer; never embed credentials or rely only on grep/max-ID
Abort on target mismatch, GPU loss, fatal error, thermal/power issue or boot failure; never auto-retry or inject again
expected_evidence: amdgpuras/driver/firmware/decoder hashes and immutable GPU/OAM target map
Pre-injection Redfish entry set/metadata and normalized bad-page set
Exact injection output, timestamp and independent RAS/XID/kernel telemetry
New CPER entry metadata, authenticated attachment URI, file hash and full decoded JSON field reconciliation
Post-injection and post-reset normalized page sets plus reset/OS/GPU health timeline and verdict
test_case.recovery: If the target, injection output, CPER correlation, reset or GPU health is abnormal, stop immediately, preserve all artifacts and use OOB plus the AMD/platform recovery procedure. Do not clear RAS EEPROM, delete logs, repeat the injection or attempt firmware/reset changes outside the approved plan.
